# Archive — M0 v1.0.0

**Status:** Superseded — retained for history and traceability. Do not edit these files; do not treat them as current.

| Archived item | Superseded by |
|---|---|
| PFS-M0-SPEC-001 **v1.0.0** (specs copy) | PFS-M0-SPEC-001 **v1.1.0** — `docs/specs/PFS-M0-SPEC-001.md` |
| M0 v1.0.0 deliverables: PFS-M0-D01…D12, PFS-M0-TRC-001 | `docs/M0-foundation/00-M0-INDEX.md` … `15-M0-REVIEW-REPORT.md` (mapping in `00-M0-INDEX.md` §4) |

The v1.0.0 material was independently reviewed as **PFS-M0-REVIEW-001**, which mandated twelve findings (F01–F12), twenty requirements (M0-REQ-001..020) and sixteen added acceptance criteria (AC-13..AC-28). Those amendments are integrated in v1.1.0 of the spec and in the `docs/M0-foundation/` package.

Archived documents reference the v1.0.0 spec section numbering (e.g., "SPEC §8 Documentation Model"), which differs from v1.1.0 section numbering (see SPEC-001 v1.1.0 §22 Change History for the mapping).
